# Effective Claude Code Usage

> A Quarto RevealJS presentation by Indrajeet Patil about using Claude Code effectively as a CLI agent for software engineering work.

This presentation explains how to use Claude Code as an agentic coding partner rather than a terminal chatbot. It covers tools, skills (using and writing them), workflows, context management, CLAUDE.md files, auto memory, subagents, background agents, planning mode, hooks, prompting strategies, MCP, Git worktrees, and non-interactive automation with `claude -p`.

Reviewed against Claude Code v2.1.318 on 5 November 2026. Command availability depends on the installed version and configuration.

## Primary URL

- [Slides](https://www.indrapatil.com/effective-claude-code-usage/)

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/IndrajeetPatil/effective-claude-code-usage/)

## Topics

- Claude Code
- Agentic coding
- CLI-based AI agents
- Tool use and slash commands
- Permission modes and Bash sandboxing
- Skills (reusable prompt playbooks) and writing your own SKILL.md
- Background agents, workflows, and multi-agent orchestration
- Context window management
- CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md durable instructions and per-repository auto memory
- Subagents and planning mode
- Goals and rewind checkpoints
- Hooks and validation workflows
- Model Context Protocol
- Git worktrees for parallel agent sessions
- Non-interactive runs with `claude -p` in scripts and CI
